decision: Should Siaya County shift feeder-road maintenance from reactive pothole patching to route-backed performance contracts with quarterly speed-index verification?

entries.item: The county's active feeder-road inventory records 412 route segments totalling 1,360 km under the roads department.
entries.source: Siaya County Roads Department inventory workbook (FY2025 close)
entries.provenance: Public demo input prepared for demos/esiasa; stands in for the department's published inventory.
entries.handling: Public demo input; proves only what the sample inventory records.

entries.item: Reactive pothole patching consumed 61% of the FY2025 feeder-road maintenance vote against a 40% plan, with no recorded closure rate per ward.
entries.source: County treasury FY2025 maintenance vote outturn
entries.provenance: Public demo input prepared for demos/esiasa; matches no confidential treasury record.
entries.handling: Public demo input; demonstrates the reactive-spend pattern only.

entries.item: The 2024 county audit sampled 18 completed patching works and found 11 degraded below usable surface within six months of handover.
entries.source: County audit office FY2024 roads sampling report
entries.provenance: Public demo input prepared for demos/esiasa; the sampling narrative is illustrative.
entries.handling: Public demo input; durability findings illustrate, not certify.

entries.item: A neighbouring county ran a two-year route-backed performance contract in which payment released only against quarterly measured geometry and travel-speed indices.
entries.source: Neighbouring county roads tender board summary
entries.provenance: Public demo input prepared for demos/esiasa; the pilot summary is illustrative.
entries.handling: Public demo input; precedent value only.

entries.item: The pilot's contracted enforcement used a third-party survey vehicle for speed-index runs with results published to the eSiasa portal each quarter.
entries.source: Neighbouring county roads tender board summary
entries.provenance: Public demo input prepared for demos/esiasa; the pilot summary is illustrative.
entries.handling: Public demo input; precedent value only.

entries.item: Ward-level complaint intake logged 2,214 feeder-road reports in FY2025, of which 38% repeated within a kilometre of a previously patched segment.
entries.provenance: Public demo input prepared for demos/esiasa; intake figures stand in for portal analytics.
entries.handling: Public demo input; shows repeat-failure geography.

entries.item: County procurement rules require multi-year service contracts above the threshold value to carry measurable output clauses and independent verification.
entries.provenance: Public demo input prepared for demos/esiasa; constraint quoted from the public manual.
entries.handling: Public demo input; binds any recommended contract design.
